title: IIT Madras makes its Computer Science Courses public
description:

IIT Madras
57600 subscribers

4 May 2022
#IITMadras has taken a unique initiative to makes its Computer Science Courses available to the students from other engineering institutions and colleges. Faculty from the Department of Computer Science, IIT Madras have created a portal containing the core courses that can be accessed by anyone interested. 

This initiative is also a major step towards realising the vision of Prof. V. Kamakoti, Director, #IITMadras, who is keen to make high quality education accessible to rural India. Those availing of this initiative can also attend quizzes on the portal for self-assessment.

title: Tools in Data Science
description: # Tools in Data Science - Jan 2026#. Tools in Data Science is a diploma level data science course at IIT Madras. Specifically: you’ll learn what tools do data scientists actually use and how. **It prepares you for AI**. AI is rapidly changing how data science work. You’ll practice using AI to learn, execute, and explain data science tasks. **Self-learning is part of the course skills**. **There is no course content**. Just challenges for you to solve, and prompts to guide you. Anyone can access this course content for free and submit assessments. You need a *good* understanding of Python, JavaScript, HTML, APIs, Excel, ChatGPT, and data science concepts. **It's a practical course. **It's a hard course. Take it in your last IITM BS Diploma term.**. * Should you take Tools in Data Science this term? **Take Graded assignment 1 to check if you’re ready for this course.** Please drop this course (do it in a later term) if you score low.
